## Doc Router
Gate 2 fires: content extends reference material in `plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md` (named-agent routing table).
DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION: Gate 2 — existing reference doc `plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md` (agent routing table).

## Overview
`plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md` contains a named-agent table. The current entry for `code-reviewer-arbiter` reads:
> "Arbiter (Opus): adjudicates severity disputes between reviewer and defense. Trinary ruling — binding, no partial accepts."
(This text mirrors the old frontmatter description in the agent file.)

After T3 rewrites the agent file, the AGENTS.md entry must be updated to match the new role:
> "Arbiter (Opus): cycle-end consolidation arbiter. Issues BLOCK/DEFER/DROP ruling per finding at end of review cycle K. Called when cycle >= max_cycles or adaptive-stability halt fires."

## File Impact
- `plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md` — MODIFY (update description for code-reviewer-arbiter entry)

## Implementation Steps
1. Read `plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md` to locate the code-reviewer-arbiter entry
2. Update the description string to reflect the new BLOCK/DEFER/DROP cycle-end role
3. Verify the frontmatter description in `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md` matches the updated AGENTS.md entry (consistency check)

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)

- [ ] AGENTS.md entry for code-reviewer-arbiter references BLOCK/DEFER/DROP
  Verify: grep -A2 "code-reviewer-arbiter" plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md | grep -q "BLOCK\|DEFER\|DROP"
- [ ] AGENTS.md entry no longer references old trinary ruling schema
  Verify: ! grep -A5 "code-reviewer-arbiter" plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md | grep -q "SUSTAIN\|ACCEPT_DEFENSE\|DOWNGRADE"
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION emitted in task completion report
  Verify: (sub-agent completion report contains DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION string)

On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
